C1790.title: CISA Warns Ransomware Gangs Exploit Unpatched SimpleHelp Remote Monitoring Tool for Intrusions
C1790.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) issued a security advisory confirming that ransomware attackers are actively exploiting vulnerabilities in unpatched SimpleHelp remote monitoring and management software to breach target networks. CISA urges software vendors, downstream customers, and end users to apply mitigations immediately.
